policy: Cases are an inventory of required scenarios, not claims of passing tests. Missing evidence blocks release. kind separates what is tested and how it gates: execution cases are executable checks of browser behaviour and gate 0.5.0 (P0); framework cases check the completeness of catalogs and mappings; process cases are assurance reviews (SBOM, Top 10, SCVS, SAMM, patch cadence) that gate release candidates, not alpha development.

cases.objective: native request bound to top/requester origin, view, epoch and profile
coveredScenarios: --media-test (engine, fake camera): request held pending until decided; deny yields no stream; grant yields a live track held as a non-persistent lease; Control Bar revoke ends a capture the page hides (no element, stop() replaced); no silent regrant after revoke

cases.objective: explicit top-level deny inherited by iframe; requester deny independent
coveredScenarios: --media-test: cross-origin iframe (localhost in 127.0.0.1) with allow=camera: the prompt names the framed requester and top site; grant gives a live track; revoke replaces the document because resetting the grant does not stop a frame's capture; a top-level deny refuses the iframe without a prompt and records the framed requester
remainingScenarios: iframe without allow=camera: the engine still asks CYBOU and CYBOU prompts and lists camera as granted, though the engine gives no stream (NotAllowedError)

cases.objective: stale ID / pending queue cancellation / revoke all fail closed
coveredScenarios: --media-test (engine, fake camera): request held pending until decided; deny yields no stream; grant yields a live track held as a non-persistent lease; Control Bar revoke ends a capture the page hides (no element, stop() replaced); no silent regrant after revoke

cases.objective: combined camera mic screen revoke without page bypass
coveredScenarios: --media-test (engine, fake camera): request held pending until decided; deny yields no stream; grant yields a live track held as a non-persistent lease; Control Bar revoke ends a capture the page hides (no element, stop() replaced); no silent regrant after revoke

--media-test: microphone grant and revoke end a hidden audio track; camera+microphone in one request share one engine decision, so revoking either ends both and the Control Bar drops both keys; screen capture is cancelled by Qt (CYBOU handles no desktopMediaRequested) after a real click, with no prompt and no stream
--media-test: a refused screen capture is cancelled by BrowserTab.onDesktopMediaRequested and recorded once as blocked, with the requesting origin, in the Screen control
remainingScenarios: real hardware device and OS capture indicator

cases.objective: system denial, background tab, sleep/resume, long calls

remainingScenarios: 2026-10-22 real-device run: live tracks from the real camera and microphone, but Windows CapabilityAccessManager records no use by CYBOU; find why, and observe whether the Windows tray indicator appears
